summary: AlembicCore CO-2: create the Core-side replacement capability/output layer needed before consumer migration. This phase must implement real stable/provisional public entrypoints for capability-oriented outputs, not a thin barrel-only reshuffle, while all old public routes remain available for downstream CO-3 migration.

targetTasks.summary: Execute only in AlembicCore. Starting from accepted CO-1 commit d92b97f57d35cc0ccbd66e362e043d9133f2c137, add/repair replacement capability/output surfaces that downstream Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicAgent can migrate to in CO-3. Required outcomes: (1) provide real public replacement entrypoints for enhancement capabilities/runtime DI adoption, test-fixture/capability test imports, ProjectContext capability output, and a clean RecipeContext facade that exposes service/factory/contracts without leaking old low-level ports/adapters/handler internals; (2) the new routes must be backed by real implementation call chains and tests, not just empty adapters, type-only placeholders, or pure barrels; (3) update package exports, public API boundary policy, smoke/import coverage, and focused tests so the new surfaces are visible and stable/provisional as appropriate; (4) keep existing legacy exports/routes available for CO-3 consumer migration, including @alembic/core/core/capability and other old AST/language/RecipeContext routes; (5) do not edit sibling repositories, vendor snapshots, release pointers, or runtime plugin packaging; (6) do not delete/internalize old routes and do not remove or reclassify the four RecipeContext unused kinds unless the current state root contains explicit later-phase confirmation; record them as pending decision/risk if encountered. Verification expected before TargetResultEnvelope: pre/post git status, focused tests for new facades, public API inventory/boundary tests as applicable, npm run build:check, npm run build, npm run smoke:public-api, npm run lint:public-api-boundary, npm run lint:consumer-core-imports, npm run test or clear explanation if a broader suite is not run, npm run lint, git diff --check and git diff --cached --check. Return a TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, raw verification commands, remaining old-route references that block CO-4 deletion, and explicit boundaries/risks.
